items.title: Dermalogica Circular Hydration Serum Review: Hyaluronic Acid, How to Use It
items.lead: Dermalogica Circular Hydration Serum: a long-lasting serum that immediately floods skin with hydration and helps prevent hydration evaporation, suitable for all skin types, especially dry or dehydrated skin.
items.hook: The Dermalogica Circular Hydration Serum: what it does and how to use it.
facts: Long-lasting serum that immediately floods skin with hydration, replenishes from within and helps prevent hydration evaporation
Suitable for all skin types, especially dryness or dehydration, dullness, fine lines or loss of firmness
Enhanced form of hyaluronic acid, algae-extract moisturizing matrix, polyglutamic acid from fermented soy
Plant sugars and amino acids, plus a postbiotic blend of Lactobacillus ferment and oat extract
Morning and night after toning, before moisturizer: 4-6 drops cover face and neck; patch test first if sensitive to an ingredient

scenes.caption: Circular Hydration Serum
scenes.say: Skin that feels tight, dull and thirsty? This is a full look at the Dermalogica Circular Hydration Serum: what it does, what is inside, and how to use it.

scenes.caption: Floods skin with hydration
scenes.say: This is a long-lasting serum that immediately floods skin with hydration. It replenishes skin from within, and helps prevent hydration from evaporating. So it works in a circle: it hydrates, it replenishes, and it helps hold that hydration in.

scenes.caption: Who it is for
scenes.say: It is suitable for all skin types, and especially for dryness or dehydration, dullness, fine lines, or loss of firmness. If your skin feels dry or dehydrated, this is the kind of serum built for that.

scenes.caption: Hyaluronic acid
scenes.say: The first key ingredient is an enhanced form of hyaluronic acid, to quench dehydrated skin. It immediately hydrates.

scenes.caption: Algae moisturizing matrix
scenes.say: An algae-extract moisturizing matrix is built in, and the hydration lasts throughout the day and beyond.

scenes.caption: Polyglutamic acid
scenes.say: Polyglutamic acid, from fermented soy, is part of the formula too, alongside the hyaluronic acid.

scenes.caption: Plant sugars + amino acids
scenes.say: So are plant sugars and amino acids.

scenes.caption: Postbiotic blend
scenes.say: There is also a postbiotic blend of Lactobacillus ferment and oat extract. Hyaluronic acid, the algae matrix, polyglutamic acid, plant sugars, amino acids, and the postbiotic blend all work together for long-lasting hydration.

scenes.caption: After toning
scenes.say: Here is how to use it. Morning and night, cleanse and tone first.

scenes.caption: 4 to 6 drops
scenes.say: Then smooth the serum over your face and neck. For most people, four to six drops cover the face and neck.

scenes.caption: Then moisturizer
scenes.say: Apply your moisturizer after it. It layers under makeup, so you can wear it in the morning before the rest of your routine.

scenes.caption: Sensitive skin
scenes.say: Sensitive skin can use it. If you are sensitive to a specific ingredient, do a patch test first. It may have a subtle natural scent.

scenes.caption: Sizes
scenes.say: It comes in ten, thirty and fifty-nine milliliter sizes. That was the Dermalogica Circular Hydration Serum. The link is in the description.

items.title: Dermalogica Dynamic Skin Strengthening Serum Review: Peptides + Squalane, How to Use It
items.lead: Dermalogica Dynamic Skin Strengthening Serum: a milky multi-defense serum with BioShield, peptides, antioxidants and squalane that strengthens barrier resilience, formulated for all skin types.
items.hook: The Dermalogica Dynamic Skin Strengthening Serum: what it does and how to use it.
facts: Milky multi-defense serum with BioShield, peptides, antioxidants and squalane that strengthens barrier resilience
Formulated for all skin types, focusing on skin aging and strengthening the skin barrier
Biomimetic peptide powered by BioShield; evergreen extract, cotton thistle, upcycled tangerine extract
Red microalgae with polyglutamic acid (30 ml)
After cleansing and toning, apply over face and neck in light, upward strokes, before moisturizer; follow with broad-spectrum SPF in the daytime

scenes.caption: Dynamic Skin Strengthening Serum
scenes.say: Want a stronger, more resilient skin barrier? This is a full look at the Dermalogica Dynamic Skin Strengthening Serum: what it does, what is inside, and how to use it.

scenes.caption: Milky multi-defense serum
scenes.say: It is a milky, multi-defense serum. It strengthens barrier resilience, and it is made for age resistance. Think of it as daily support for a stronger skin barrier.

scenes.caption: Who it is for
scenes.say: It is formulated for all skin types, with a focus on skin aging and strengthening the skin barrier.

scenes.caption: Biomimetic peptide
scenes.say: The star is a biomimetic peptide, powered by BioShield. A peptide is the backbone of this formula, and it is there for barrier resilience.

scenes.caption: Antioxidants + squalane
scenes.say: It is paired with antioxidants and squalane, which complete the multi-defense blend.

scenes.caption: Evergreen + cotton thistle
scenes.say: You will also find evergreen extract and cotton thistle.

scenes.caption: Upcycled tangerine
scenes.say: Plus upcycled tangerine extract.

scenes.caption: Red microalgae
scenes.say: And red microalgae with polyglutamic acid. So that is a peptide, antioxidants, squalane, evergreen, cotton thistle, tangerine and red microalgae in one milky serum.

scenes.caption: Cleanse and tone
scenes.say: Here is how to use it. Cleanse your skin first. It works morning or evening, after toning.

scenes.caption: Light, upward strokes
scenes.say: Apply it over your face and neck in light, upward strokes.

scenes.caption: Then moisturizer
scenes.say: Then follow with your moisturizer, so the serum sits between your toner and your moisturizer.

scenes.caption: Daytime SPF
scenes.say: In the daytime, finish with a broad-spectrum sunscreen. This step matters every day, especially when you are working on skin aging.

scenes.caption: 30 ml
scenes.say: It comes in a thirty milliliter bottle. It is a good fit if you want a serum that focuses on your skin barrier and on age resistance.

scenes.caption: Summary
scenes.say: That was the Dermalogica Dynamic Skin Strengthening Serum: a milky serum with a peptide, antioxidants and squalane, for barrier resilience. The link is in the description.
